turns: Can you find me a good ramen place near the office?
Three close by: Ippudo on 4th (rich tonkotsu, 8 min walk), Menya Rui (lighter shoyu), and Ramen Tatsu-ya (busy at lunch). Ippudo takes reservations.
What should I pack for Lisbon in June?
Light layers, a light jacket for the evening wind, comfortable shoes for the hills and cobblestones, sunscreen, and a plug adapter (type F).
Help me write a message to my landlord about the broken heater.
Here is a draft: Hi Mark, the heater in the living room stopped working on Monday. Could someone come to fix it this week? Thanks.
Compare the Kindle Paperwhite and the Kobo Clara.
The Paperwhite has a bigger 7-inch screen and Audible; the Kobo Clara reads EPUB natively and borrows library books through OverDrive. Both are waterproof.
How do I fix the error when my shell script will not start?
Make it executable with chmod +x script.sh, or run it with bash script.sh. Check the folder is not mounted noexec.
Give me a 3-day beginner workout plan.
Day 1: squats, push-ups, rows. Day 2: rest or a 30-minute walk. Day 3: lunges, overhead press, plank. Start with 2 sets of 10.
